about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/lower: edits of the package's source that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants lower; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded from the test-speed plan (wf10, 2026-11-08) and the units' verify mutants.

mutants.name: forms-const-divisor
mutants.rule: A package let read as a divisor stays a Go variable: a constant zero divisor is a Go build error, where Ergo raises the run's defect.

mutants.name: forms-const-fold
mutants.rule: A package let added to a constant stays a Go variable: Go folds two constants at build time, where an overflow is an error, not the run's wrap.

mutants.name: forms-map-sameplace

mutants.name: forms-map-type

mutants.name: forms-sole-row

mutants.name: forms-alias-once

mutants.name: forms-sole-footprint

mutants.name: forms-sole-goerror
mutants.rule: rows.md Catch 6: a catch of an Ergo call failing go.Error keeps its type switch and re-panicking default.

mutants.name: forms-drop-stmt
mutants.rule: Only a call whose statement discards its value goes to the variant with no result.

mutants.name: forms-drop-result
mutants.rule: The variant with no result returns nothing: each return evaluates its value for its effects alone.

mutants.name: forms-drop-reference
mutants.rule: The reference lowering (formLowering reference) calls the function itself.

mutants.name: known-variant-drops-loop-poll

mutants.name: known-literal-purity-blind
mutants.rule: runtime.md I1, Known callbacks: a literal with an opaque footprint keeps the uniform ABI and its callee's entry poll.
mutants.gap: Equivalent in every program the property writes: a literal that calls a function value runs the same code under either ABI, and the dropped entry poll is observable only as the moment a pending stop is seen. A literal with a capability, a failure or a task start is refused by plainSig and bodyNeedsFrame before purity is asked.

mutants.name: arena-free-keeps-live

mutants.name: arena-free-returns-new

mutants.name: arena-set-skips-check

mutants.name: arena-update-skips-check

mutants.name: arena-update-copies

mutants.name: arena-get-skips-check

mutants.name: arena-free-skips-check

mutants.rule: types.md Laws: a generated Option argument goes into the flat Option by its variant's tag.

mutants.name: option-wire-swapped
mutants.from: b.WriteString("case " + strconv.Itoa(k) + ":\n" + x + " := " + fu.flatNarrow(tc, v, k) + "\n")
mutants.to: b.WriteString("case " + strconv.Itoa(len(u.Variants)-1-k) + ":\n" + x + " := " + fu.flatNarrow(tc, v, k) + "\n")
mutants.rule: wire: a record's Option field round-trips: the encoder writes the variant the tag names.

mutants.name: option-state-key-payload
mutants.from: line("\t" + l.keyStmt(vt, k, fu.flatNarrow(tc, v, i), site))
mutants.rule: types.md Laws 13: a machine state that holds an Option keys its states by the Option's variant and payload, so a law counts each state once.

mutants.name: option-listed-unflat
mutants.rule: types.md Laws: a listed Option argument goes into the flat Option by its variant's tag.

mutants.name: option-map-key-unconverted
mutants.rule: types.md Unions 6: a variant written as a Map key goes into the flat Option the key type is.
